slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Continental report on the October 2016 APAI-CRVS self-reported monitoring round; Sao Tome and Principe appears only in the annex score bands (digitization composite under 35%; planning, coordination and monitoring 80-100%; infrastructure and resources 50-64%; overall 65-79%). The digitization composite mixes electronic capture, notification, transmission and identity linkage, so it states no value for any aspect, and the per-question tables give counts of countries without naming them; no system is named.
